title: Lhabab Duchen
hookLine: in Tibet, the day the Buddha descended after teaching his mother in heaven

lines: HE WENT UP TO TEACH HER.
cards: The Buddha's mother, Maya, died seven days after he was born. He never knew her. The tradition tells a story about that loss.
Many years later, after his awakening, the Buddha rose to a heaven where his mother had been reborn as a god, and spent a whole rains retreat there teaching her. Then he came back down.
In Tibet, the day he came down is one of four great holy days of the year.

teach.b: The story is told in the commentaries and later texts, with many variations.
In the Theravada telling, the Buddha spent the rains in the Heaven of the Thirty-Three, where his mother, reborn among the gods, came to hear him, and he taught the higher teaching, the Abhidhamma.
Each day, the story goes, he passed a summary to Sariputta on earth, which is one way the tradition explains how the Abhidhamma reached the world.

When the rains ended, he descended at a place called Sankassa, on a staircase the gods made: by tradition a jeweled stair in the middle, with gold and silver stairs on either side, the gods Brahma and Sakka attending him.

Crowds waited at the bottom. In Tibetan, Lhabab Duchen means 'the great occasion of the descent from the realm of the gods.' It falls on the twenty-second day of the ninth Tibetan month, usually in November.
People visit temples, make offerings, recite, circle stupas and holy places, and give generously.

In Thailand, the same descent is remembered at the end of the rains with a great alms round, where monks walk down a hill or steps, like the Buddha coming down to the waiting crowd. Notice the shape of the story.
He went up to give his mother the best thing he had. Then he came back down, to the people waiting. He didn't stay in heaven.

how: On Lhabab Duchen, Tibetan Buddhists visit temples, make offerings, recite prayers and mantras, circle stupas and give generously; in Thailand the descent is remembered at the end of the rains with a large alms-giving ceremony.

games.q: you've spent a whole rains retreat teaching your mother in a heaven of the gods. the season ends. what do you do?
o: stay with her among the gods.
come back down to the people waiting.
games.why: he descends at Sankassa on a stair the gods made. the festival celebrates the coming down as much as the going up.

practice: Bring to mind your mother, or whoever mothered you: a grandmother, an aunt, a foster parent, a teacher, a friend; if that relationship is painful or absent, choose someone else who cared for you, or simply wish well to all mothers.
Picture giving them the best thing you have to give: time, a word of thanks, a kindness. Then picture coming back down to your ordinary day, carrying that warmth with you.

wordCard.voice: Lhabab Duchen. The Tibetan holy day of the Buddha's descent, after a rains retreat spent teaching his mother in heaven. Today's word.
